mangohud.label: MangoHud
mangohud.description: Shows FPS, CPU/GPU usage, and temperatures in game.

gamemode.label: GameMode
gamemode.description: Requests temporary system performance optimizations while the game is running.

gamescope.label: Gamescope
gamescope.description: Runs the game inside a Gamescope session.

dxvk-async.label: Asynchronous pipeline compilation (DXVK)
dxvk-async.description: Enables DXVK asynchronous pipeline compilation. Requires compatible patched DXVK.

dxvk-hdr.label: DXVK HDR
dxvk-hdr.description: Advertises HDR10 color space to DXVK games. Requires an HDR-capable compositor, display, and Vulkan 1.3.

nvidia-nvapi.label: NVIDIA NVAPI
nvidia-nvapi.description: Lets games access NVIDIA-specific features such as DLSS.

proton-hdr.label: Legacy custom-Proton HDR
proton-hdr.description: Enables the older PROTON_ENABLE_HDR path only in custom Proton builds that still advertise it.

proton-log.label: Proton debug log
proton-log.description: Enables Proton troubleshooting logs (steam-<id>.log in the home directory).

amd-fsr4.label: FSR 4 upgrade
amd-fsr4.description: Upgrades supported FSR 3.1 games through the selected custom Proton build. Requires compatible AMD hardware/drivers.
